name: Kitagawa Yuki
source:
In addition to being addicted to online gaming, Yuki specializes in programming and is enthusiastic when it comes to the latest technological development. She's close friends with [url=/c98277]Mai[/url], and refers to her as her older sister. Yuki also has a crush on the [url=/c98200]Protagonist[/url], and, with Mai's encouragement, is trying to get closer with him.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
